directions.name: Rosehip Red
directions.idea: The shop is named after the wild rose hip, so the whole page becomes one saturated hip-red field crossed by a single giant drawn briar branch, like a stem laid on the counter before binding.

palette.role: line drawing and rules, deep hip

directions.type: Bricolage Grotesque ExtraBold for the wordmark and headline, set tight and very large; Inter Regular for running text and lists. The type feels hand-sized and lively, yet stays a plain sans.
directions.composition: Hero: the left 7 columns hold a huge wordmark-scale headline in off-white on red, with the intro and one square-cornered button below it. A dark-red line drawing of a briar branch with hips enters from the right edge and runs down behind the type into the next section. Section 2 is a white field: the four services as a left-aligned stacked list with thin rules and large names in red, plus the note set beside them in columns 9–12. Section 3 returns to red, with the phone as a giant numeral spanning 10 columns, the hours table and address on the left, and a schematic map line drawing on the right.
directions.imagery: A single continuous line drawing of a dog-rose briar (stem, thorns, leaves, oval hips) in one deep colour, with small leaf-green touches. There are no photos and no AI artwork.
directions.signature: One unbroken briar branch drawn across the page from the hero down through the services, so scrolling feels like following one stem.
directions.imagePrompt: One flat full-page desktop website screenshot, 1536×1024, with no browser or device frame. Page ground is saturated rosehip red #B3261E. Top left is the wordmark "Šipek" in heavy rounded grotesque in off-white #FBF4EF, with the small line "cvetličarna" beneath it in lowercase regular sans. Navigation sits top right in small off-white sans: "Domov", "Šopki", "Poroke", "Kontakt". The left 7 columns hold the enormous headline "Šopki iz cvetja tega tedna" in tight extra-bold grotesque, off-white, across three lines. Below it is the intro in regular sans: "Majhna cvetličarna na Glavnem trgu v Novem mestu. Šopke vežemo sproti, iz sezonskega cvetja z vrtnarij v Beli krajini." Under that is one rectangular square-cornered off-white button with red text, "Pokličite", next to "031 555 427". From the right edge, a large single-weight line drawing of a wild dog-rose branch with thorns, leaves and oval hips in deep red #5E0F0C, with a few leaves filled green #2F5D3A, passes behind the headline and continues down off the screen. The lower third shows the start of a pure white section. On it, a left-aligned stacked list separated by thin rules shows large red names "Šopki po naročilu", "Poročna floristika", "Žalni aranžmaji", "Sobne rastline". To the right, in off-black #1E1412: "Šopek naročite po telefonu dan prej.", the hours "Pon–pet 8.00–19.00" and "Sob 8.00–13.00", and "Glavni trg 9, 8000 Novo mesto". The look is flat, with no gradients, no shadows, nothing centred and no photos.

directions.name: Week Print
directions.idea: Because every bouquet depends on what came in from Bela krajina this week, the page reads like a weekly printed sheet: deep garden green with two-colour linocut stems and the week itself laid out as a strip.
directions.type: Fraunces at a high optical size in SemiBold, upright only, for the wordmark and headline; Work Sans for text, lists and hours. The pairing reads as a sharp printed broadsheet on a dark ground.
directions.composition: Hero: the headline sits low-left across 8 columns, with the intro and button underneath. A tall linocut print of seasonal stems fills columns 9–12 and bleeds off the top and right edges. Section 2 is a full-width week strip of six equal cells, Pon to Sob, on a darker green: the hours sit inside the strip, the note sits in orange under the last cell, and the phone appears as a big numeral at left. Section 3 is a two-column split, with the four services as large serif lines on the left and the address with a schematic street map of Glavni trg on the right.
directions.imagery: A labelled AI-made artwork imitating a two-colour linocut print of loose seasonal stems and leaves in orange and pale green on the dark ground. It contains no text, people or premises.
directions.signature: The opening hours shown as a six-day week strip, tying the shop's rhythm to the 'flowers of this week' promise.
